title: Zesty Miso Jamaican Haddock Bowl
description: A flavorful and nutritious Jamaican-inspired dish featuring haddock marinated in a zesty miso sauce, served over low-glycemic cauliflower rice in an earthenware bowl. This recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a blender or food processor, combine miso paste, lime juice, soy sauce, brown sugar, and scotch bonnet peppers, and blend until smooth.
Place the haddock fillets in a shallow dish and brush the miso marinade evenly over both sides of the fish.
Let the fish marinate for at least 15 minutes, or up to 30 minutes in the refrigerator.
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and arrange the marinated haddock fillets on it.
Drizzle the coconut oil over the fish and season with salt and black pepper.
Bake the fish in the preheated oven for 12-15 minutes, or until cooked through.
While the fish is cooking, heat a tablespoon of coconut oil in a large skillet over medium heat and saute the cauliflower rice until tender.
To assemble the bowls, divide the cooked cauliflower rice among four earthenware bowls, then top each bowl with a piece of cooked haddock and garnish with chopped scallions.
